text:
Raj (AE): FinEdge asked Redwood to be a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. Must-haves: x-api-key header present, identical JSON keys for downstream lib, same 4xx/5xx bodies, webhook callbacks for async jobs. POC window 3 weeks, smoke in 10 business days.
Maya (Solutions Eng): copy. need their OpenAPI + ~50 sample calls. we'll scope to non-streaming sync endpoint for smoke.
Raj (AE): link sent to the drive. they use top-level "id" and nested "trace.context" fields we must preserve.
Oliver (SRE): recommend staging pool 3x T4 equiv -> autoscale to 6. creating INF-4933. ops-bot: INF-4933 created.
Maya (Solutions Eng): plan: lightweight proxy shim that accepts x-api-key, translates auth to Redwood, remaps response keys (id, trace) and preserves X-Request-ID and billing headers. error_map for 429/401 to match competitor shape.
Tina (Security): they want SOC2 answers + confirmation on KMS and retention. sec-bot: questionnaire tracked at https://redwood.internal/sec/q/finedge-v2.json :lock:
Tina (Security): staging ok with our KMS; prod will require customer-managed KMS and deletion proofs.
Raj (AE): pricing ask: they bill per request + per-token. can we run token-delta on 50 samples?
Maya (Solutions Eng): yes will run 50 samples through both and report token deltas + diffs in tokens/response shape.
Oliver (SRE): blockers: client IP allowlist, webhook callback CORS verification, and cert pinning. need those before E2E.
Maya (Solutions Eng): deliverables: 1) proxy shim prototype, 2) parity report (50 samples), 3) error mapping table, 4) bench numbers from staging.
Raj (AE): acceptance tests from client: key presence for 20 calls, identical error bodies for induced 429/401, token accounting within 3%.
Maya (Solutions Eng): noted. if they insist on identical timestamps we can inject server_time but it will differ by ms; will flag.
Tina (Security): I'll prepare SOC2/KMS answers and draft a short note on PII retention for POC.
Oliver (SRE): staging-redwood-finedge provisioned, creds in vault. will post load numbers once warm.
Raj (AE): thanks team. I'll confirm acceptance criteria and sample set with FinEdge. :thumbsup:
